object.attr: derived: CF-S21, CF-S22, D17, review Q43. An external entity, an external DTD or an image link in a file from a pull could put a local file into Mellon's output or a PDF, or connect to a host that learns who opened the document. Decided on 2026-11-10.
object.description: When Mellon reads, draws or exports a data file or figure file, Mellon shall not read another file or network resource that the file refers to.
